Aesop, measured

Every value on this page is a CSS custom property generated from tokens.json, measured on the live US storefront at aesop.com: the warm cream ground, the single ink doing text, keylines and button fills, the one tannin-amber accent on badges and promo links, the 1px hairlines (many drawn as box-shadows), the square corners and the quiet Suisse Intl voice. The storefront paints a single light theme — there is no dark variant, so there is no theme toggle. The drawings below are rebuilt from the tokens; the real pixels are in screenshots/ and components/crops/.

Read from aesop.com on 2026-11-10, publicly, signed out, on the US storefront (Sites-aesop-us-Site). Suisse Intl and Circular Std are proprietary and not loaded here: they fall back to Helvetica Neue/Helvetica/Arial.

Colour

Warm near-monochrome: one ink #333333 sets text, keylines and the dark button fills on a cream ground #fffef2, with beige steps for secondary surfaces and field hairlines. One accent — a tannin amber #945c26 — marks badges, promos and inline links. The dark footer inverts to cream-on-ink.

Typography

Suisse Intl in two cuts: the regular sets body text, prices and headings; the medium sets nav items, buttons and badges — all sentence case, never uppercase. The scale runs 11–30px: 12/18 small text, 14/21 body, 24/30 page titles, 30/30 the one display heading. Circular Std appears on the PDP product title.

The Aesop Valise

Shape, sizes and space

Almost nothing is rounded — the quicklink pills carry a 4px corner, the Map/Satellite toggle 2px, and the filter count dot is a 50% circle; every control edge stays square. Fields are 40px tall, buttons and CTA cards 48px, drawers 400–405px, the sign-up dialog 970px. Borders are always 1px hairlines — the ink keyline, the 20%-ink field keyline, or cream on dark — several painted as box-shadow rather than border.

Radius

Focus

No measured control paints a focus ring: keyboard focus lands (26 elements were given a real Tab focus), but the computed outline width stays 0. Focus is a colour shift at most — the field keyline doubles to a 1px inset shadow, links take the hover state.

focusRing · 0px, none painted
on dark fills · none painted

Motion

Short, gentle eases: the header controls fade colour over 0.5s ease-out, field keylines ease over 0.2s, the ink buttons and hero CTA over 0.25s ease-out, the quicklink pills over 0.3s. The stylesheets add a 0.1s max-height reveal on accordions and a 0.4s padding slide on the sliding panels. Click a track to play it.

Layout

A two-tier header — a 30px utility row over a 50.8px nav row (50px at 390) — then a fluid grid under a 720px campaign hero. The PLP runs a 400px filter rail beside the tile grid; the PDP is a two-column canvas; overlays are the 405px cart drawer and the 970px sign-up dialog. Hairline 1px rules separate everything.
